package widget

type firstStore struct { offset int }

//go:noinline
func (store firstStore) read(first, second int) int {
	total := first + second
	for index := 0; index < 5; index++ { total += index }
	if total > store.offset { return total + store.offset }
	return total
}

func (store firstStore) write(first, second int) []int {
	values := []int{first, second, store.offset, first + second, first - second, first * second, first / (second + 1), first % (second + 1)}
	for index := range values { values[index] += store.offset }
	return values
}

func (store firstStore) remove(first, second int) bool {
	switch first {
	case second: return true
	case store.offset: return false
	default: return first + second > 7
	}
}
